verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is scripted natively in JavaScript/TypeScript, and since these bindings ARE the engine API, full API exposure is inherent; docs confirm 'TypeScript support with full IntelliSense' and dedicated debugging tools (Inspector/Scene Inspector for runtime scene debugging), corroborated by community praise for the Spector.js WebGL debugger extension as a major productivity win. Community also independently confirms strong TypeScript integration ('integration with TypeScript works well') and easier-to-follow API/object naming versus competitors. Missing for 10: no first-party breakdown of debugger feature completeness (breakpoints/step-through in TS) and no independent benchmark of IntelliSense coverage across the full API surface.
